create_pipeline_with_convert_token: create a Pipeline with a custom convert_token function to transform sequence data
run_pipeline_on_input: run the Pipeline on input data by calling it with a string or list of tokens
add_pipeline_before: add a Pipeline or callable to be applied before the current Pipeline using add_before
add_pipeline_after: add a Pipeline or callable to be applied after the current Pipeline using add_after
review_pipeline_call_method: review the Pipeline call method that applies convert_token to each element in a list
